validation_protocol.outer_fit: one constrained model per earlier source OOF season; equal source-season correction average
validation_protocol.source_target: source R target-minus-base residual centered inside source R
validation_protocol.application: R only; F bitwise immutable base

direction_coding.outs_positive: positive coefficient means residual rises with outs
direction_coding.earlier_inning: -clip(inning,1,12)/4; positive coefficient means residual falls with inning
direction_coding.latent_late: (strict lowrank - team base) * I(inning>=7); positive coefficient

signal_audit.status: same-fold diagnostic only; not an outer-fold fit input

signal_interpretation.retained: R outs(+), inning(-), RISP(+), log(LI)(+) were sign-stable; latent x late-inning was the only inspected latent interaction with the same positive sign in 2022-2024 R diagnostics.
signal_interpretation.excluded: Count progression/depth, score difference, base-state categories, F main effect, and other latent interactions changed sign or regime.

selection.status: post-hoc diagnostic ranking only; no same-fold deployment selection
